verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a structured API reference (an api-reference/sonar-post page with response schemas) backed by a live OpenAPI spec. It also documents its own interactive Playground for running Search queries with no API key, which gives users a runnable, explorable surface. However, nothing shows that the API reference pages themselves are interactive or offer in-page 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: evidence that the reference pages are interactive with runnable request examples, Playground coverage beyond Search (e.g., Sonar/Agent endpoints), independent or hands-on corroboration.
